environment.cpu: Intel Core i9-11900KF (8 cores, 16 threads), threads used: 16 (plus single-thread runs up to 10^4 points)
environment.build_type: Release, no -march=native (AVX2 row kernels via target_clones)

timing: One untimed warmup (rigid auto and low-rank nonrigid at 1000 points); each configuration measured 3 times up to 10^4 points and 2 times at 10^5; runtime_ms is the median, min/max per run in sealed-result.json (spread <= 2% everywhere). No iteration observer inside the timed region.

outcomes.single_thread_dense_vs_reference: 1.9x at 10^4 points (vectorized row kernels, same exact arithmetic up to summation order)

rigid_100000_points.reference: not run (single-threaded O(N M) would take hours)

outcomes.rigid_max_point_delta: <= 1.4e-12 against the reference (all policies, <= 10^4 points); 8.1e-14 auto against dense at 10^5 points
outcomes.fast_gauss: slower than dense at every measured size (1.78 s vs 28 ms at 10^3, 5.3 s vs 2.2 s at 10^4) and reported as cpu_mixed: some iterations found no plan meeting the bound and fell back to dense

nonrigid_low_rank.1000_points: 41 ms (k=50) vs 1098 ms full kernel (26.8x), max delta 2.8e-5 (k=50) and 2.7e-7 (k=150, effective rank 73) against the full kernel
nonrigid_low_rank.10000_and_100000_points: full kernel not applicable (limit 8192); parity only low rank 150 vs 50 (<= 5.2e-5); RMS to truth 1.2e-5 (k=50) and 3.0-3.1e-6 (k=150, effective rank 74)

parity_scope: Parity against the METHOD-015 reference is proven for rigid policies up to 10^4 points and for the low-rank nonrigid solve at 10^3 points (against the reference-parity full kernel); beyond that it is chained (auto vs dense at 10^5, low rank 150 vs 50 at 10^4 and 10^5).
deviations: Supersedes the single-run evidence bound to d6b6ab494 (superseded-d6b6ab494/), which Fable and Codex reviewed: it timed one run per configuration with the trace observer inside the timed region. Timings moved by under 5% (10^4 auto 1454 -> 1386 ms, 10^5 auto 198293 -> 197877 ms); rigid parity and RMS are unchanged, while the low-rank runs at 10^5 now stop after 84 and 100 iterations (was 92 and 116) with RMS 1.24e-5 and 3.0e-6, after the review fixes to the low-rank M-step.

The first bound run (source cc5344978, first-run-result.json, first-run-trace.log.gz) failed the gate: nonrigid low-rank hit the 60-iteration cap at 100000 points and truncated rows ran about ten times slower in index order.
not_measured: Memory peak; cross-host timings; the reference at 100000 points; explicit truncated and fast Gauss policies at 100000 points (skipped above the reference cap, see paper.md).
